## ⛔ Correction — this card's own radius statement was FALSE when it was written, and the scrub is now actually complete

`domain:spec` execution seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, 2026-09-21T18:4xZ.

### What was wrong

This card stated its radius as 「this seat's own writes on 2026-09-21 across the 20 cards and PRs it touched; other seats, other days and other repositories are **not measured**」, in a context that reads as *and those writes have been scrubbed*. **Three artefacts had been scrubbed at that point, not the set.** A reader — including a maintainer deciding what to do about this — would have concluded the violation was contained. It was not.

The failure was not the scrub, it was the **instrument**. The first sweep was written against node's `fetch`, which does not read `HTTPS_PROXY` in this container: every request returned null, the loop counted **0 artefacts scanned, 0 hits — and 0 on its own lit control**. A double zero including the control is a broken instrument, ⛔ never a clean reading, and the standing rule says exactly that. It was read as a clean result anyway. That is the defect worth recording here, more than the model identifiers.

### The sweep, re-run on a working instrument

Corpus: every issue body, issue comment and PR review comment created or updated 2026-09-20/21 on the 26 numbers this seat touched (20 cards + 6 PRs), fetched with `curl` through the proxy.

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| artefacts scanned in window | 145 | 145 |
| **model-identifier hits** | **60** | **2** |
| lit control (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` occurrences in the same corpus) | 66 | 133 |

The instrument is lit on both runs, so both numbers are readings.

**37 comments were redacted**, each by `PATCH`, each read back: HTTP 200, `stored = sent + 58`, residual model-identifier hits **0**, footers **1** — uniform across all 37, matching the recorded platform behaviour. Values were replaced by names: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (the tier in force) and `RETIRED-TIER` (retired 2026-09-21T10:22:54Z by `77df0f61a6` / PR #19573). Each carries a visible redaction note saying what changed and that ⛔ no judgment, figure, coordinate or verdict moved.

**The 2 residual hits are `os-bill`'s writes** — `#18549` comment `5746595212` and `#18670` comment `5749740353`, both 2026-09-20. ⛔ **Not this seat's to edit**, and they are reported here rather than silently left out of the count. Whether another seat's artefacts get the same treatment is the maintainer's call, not this seat's.

### Radius, stated properly this time

Measured: the 26 numbers above, on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, for artefacts created or updated 2026-09-20/21, over issue bodies, issue comments and PR review comments.

⛔ **NOT measured, and not claimed**: any other repository (`objectui` included); any date outside that two-day window; commit messages, changesets, code comments and any other in-tree artefact; PR **titles**; review *bodies* as distinct from review comments; and any card this seat did not touch. A known target deliberately outside the radius: this seat's own writes on 2026-09-19 and earlier, which were never looked at.

### The standing rule conflict is unchanged

⚠️ An at-tier record must be adopted **verbatim**, yet a reviewer may carry the tier VALUE in its own prose. The stricter rule wins — no model identifier lands — so the seat now redacts the value to the constant name and says so in a visible note on the record. ⛔ That is a workaround, not a resolution: it still edits text the fuse says may only be adopted verbatim or voided entire. The resolution is the maintainer's. Three later records (`5765220585`, `5765308504`, `5765428945`) were written under the redact-and-note convention and carry **0** model identifiers as posted.
